name: FoamCoupling
description: An engine for coupling Yade with the finite volume fluid solver OpenFOAM in parallel. Requirements : Yade compiled with MPI libs, OpenFOAM-6 (openfoam is not required for compilation).Yade is executed under MPI environment with OpenFOAM simultaneously, and using MPI communication routines data...

attributes.name: fluidDomains
attributes.description: list of fluid domain bounding fictitious fluid bodies that has the fluid mesh bounds

methods.name: SetOpenFoamSolver
methods.description: Starts the Yade coupled OpenFOAM solver with the requested number of processes

methods.name: eraseId
methods.description: remove a body from hydrodynamic force coupling

methods.name: getFluidDomainBbox
methods.description: get the fluid domain bounding boxes, called once during simulation initialization.

methods.name: getIdList
methods.description: get the ids of bodies in coupling

methods.name: getNumBodies
methods.description: get the number of bodies in the coupling

methods.name: insertBodyId
methods.description: insert a new body id for hydrodynamic force coupling

methods.name: killMPI
methods.description: Destroy MPI, to be called at the end of the simulation, from killMPI<FoamCoupling::killMPI>

methods.name: setIdList
methods.description: list of body ids in hydroForce coupling. (links to :yref: `FoamCoupling::bodyList` vector, used to build particle data FoamCoupling::particleData. FoamCoupling::particleData contains the particle pos, vel, angvel, radius and this is sent to foam. )
